summary: The plan is well-structured and comprehensive. It faithfully implements the architect's recommended Approach A (HealthCheck Protocol + HealthCheckRunner + adapter migration) with clear two-phase delivery. All 6 scope items from issue #850 are addressed. The 11 tasks across 2 phases have correct dependency ordering, specific testable acceptance criteria, and a thorough test strategy. Design decisions (DD-1 through DD-9) provide strong rationale for key choices. Minor observations noted but none warrant revision: (1) test count claim of '23 combined tests' is inaccurate — actual count is 28 (16 container_monitor + 12 startup_reconciliation); (2) plan should note that EventType.HEALTH_CHECK already exists in events.py; (3) PHASE_COMPLETE trigger is wired into the internal execution flow in routes/pipelines.py but the external phase advancement endpoint in routes/phases.py is not considered; (4) no documentation update task for the new /api/v1/pipelines/{id}/health endpoint.
